var dir = "/home/andr/WORK/GAGG/DynamicPET/OutCombined"

dir += "/images"
var fn = dir + "/images_it3.hdr"
var arPair = pet.loadImage(fn)

var data  = arPair[0] // [ix][iy][iz]
var parAr = arPair[1]

var numBinsAr  = parAr[0]
var binsX = numBinsAr[0]
var binsY = numBinsAr[1]
var binsZ = numBinsAr[2]

var mmPerPixAr = parAr[1]
var mmX = mmPerPixAr[0]
var mmY = mmPerPixAr[1]
var mmZ = mmPerPixAr[2]
//var offsetAr   = parAr[2]

core.print("Num bins (xyz):", binsX, binsY, binsZ)
core.print("mm per pixel (xyz):", mmX, mmY, mmZ)

var rangeX = mmX * 0.5 * binsX
var rangeY = mmY * 0.5 * binsY
var rangeZ = mmZ * 0.5 * binsZ

hist.new3D("3d", binsX, -rangeX, rangeX,
                 binsY, -rangeY, rangeY,
                 binsZ, -rangeZ, rangeZ)

for (var ix = 0; ix < numBinsAr[0]; ix++)
for (var iy = 0; iy < numBinsAr[1]; iy++)
for (var iz = 0; iz < numBinsAr[2]; iz++)
{
    hist.fill("3d", -rangeX + ix * mmX + 0.001,
                    -rangeY + iy * mmY + 0.001,
                    -rangeZ + iz * mmZ + 0.001,  data[ix][iy][iz])
}

hist.setAxisTitles("3d", "X, mm", "Y, mm", "Z, mm")

hist.draw("3d", "box2")

var dir = "/home/andr/WORK/GAGG/DynamicPET/OutCombined"
dir += "/images"

var fn = dir + "/images_it3.hdr"
grwin.show3D(fn)
